# Test Fixtures

Test-only data for The House v2 suites.

## Curling Canada reference fixtures (clearly marked)

Any curling-specific data (PTSO/MA, club, curler, bonspiel, etc.) used in tests lives here
and **must be clearly labelled as curling reference data**. It exists to exercise the
NSO-generic core via the Curling Canada reference profile — it does **not** make the core
curling-specific.
